description: Session-level behavioral anomaly detection result produced by Isolation Forest inference.

limitations: Isolation Forest detects statistical deviations from the normal training baseline, not confirmed malicious attacks or verified vulnerabilities.

aggregate_example.notes: Isolation Forest anomaly assessment operates independently of Random Forest risk scoring.

status_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: Session lacked critical evidence or minimum packets for reliable anomaly scoring
status_definitions.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: Model or preprocessor artifact not loaded; analysis safely proceeded without anomaly scoring
status_definitions.ANALYSIS_ERROR: Exception encountered during feature extraction or scoring; shielded to prevent pipeline disruption

classification_definitions.ANOMALOUS: Observation identified as outlier by Isolation Forest decision function (score < threshold)
classification_definitions.WITHIN_BASELINE: Observation aligns with learned normal baseline distribution (score >= threshold)
classification_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: No classification attempted due to incomplete capture or missing key fields
classification_definitions.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: Model was not available at runtime
